tweet.text:
This feels like a broadly accurate description of the situation: our industry may be on track to build systems that impose an unprecedented amount of risk on the world.

Evaluating those risks, and changing incentive structures so we can address them, is why I'm joining METR.

quote.text: I resigned from Anthropic today. I spent the last three years doing pretraining research at both OpenAI and Anthropic. Neither company is acting responsibly. They are racing straight to self-improving superintelligence and gambling with our lives. More thoughts below.
